artist_bio: Ada Example is a painter working in oil and cold wax. She has shown throughout New England since 2009.
title: Low Tide
medium: Oil and cold wax on panel
description:
The panel was prepared with six coats of absorbent ground, sanded between each, until the surface held pigment the way blotting paper holds ink.

The final layers were scraped back with a razor to expose the earlier ones. Note the blank line above: that is what separates paragraphs.

artist_bio: Ben Sample makes collage from salvaged printed matter.
title: Transit Papers
description: Built from bus transfers and ticket stubs collected over fourteen months, adhered with wheat paste and sealed under thin acrylic glazes.
